description.fun: Bruxish is a dazzling reef fish that grinds its teeth to fire up its brain and make psychic energy, and the grinding noise alone sends nearby Pokémon fleeing. It buries itself in the sea floor with only the bulb on its head poking out, using it as a psychic radar, then blasts prey with headaches that knock them out. Alolan lifeguards like having it around, since it keeps dangerous Water Pokémon away.
description.guide: Bruxish is a Water- and Psychic-type Pokémon from Alola that may be based on the reef triggerfish, Hawaii's state fish. It produces psychic power by grinding its teeth and stuns prey with it. Its Dazzling Ability is unique to it.
description.tagline: A psychedelic reef fish that grinds its teeth into psychic power
